summary: The detector found road cracking with up to 92% confidence. Severity is High: 1 crack area (alligator (fatigue) cracking) covering 24% of the photo. Widespread alligator cracking usually means the road base is failing and potholes will follow. Coverage depends on how close the photo was taken, so an inspector should confirm the size.
recommended_action: Inspect the road base and plan resurfacing before the cracking turns into potholes.
